description: REAL ACTION: sends a WhatsApp message to a lead, a contact or a bare number, and records it on that record's timeline. Recipient: exactly one of lead_id, contact_id or to_number (E.164, no record needed - it is matched like find_by_phone, incl. contact mobiles; with no unique match the entry is kept as 'unassigned'). Consent, legal basis and purpose are checked for leads AND contacts. Beeper: the chat is the one linked to the record, otherwise the WhatsApp chat of the number - found or started on the bridge (startWhatsappChat; starting sends nothing) and only used if a participant really has that number. dry_run:true resolves everything (recipient, consent, route, chat) and sends NOTHING. Which way it goes out is the tenant's setting (tenants.whatsapp_provider): 'beeper' sends through the local bridge from a personal account, 'twilio' sends through the connected AI-Call-Bot from one of its numbers, and 'twilio_direct' sends WhatsApp Business straight from the tenant's OWN Twilio account and approved sender. The timeline entry is the same either way. Required: body and one recipient. Optional: to_number next to a record = send to that number instead, chat_id (beeper, defaults to the linked WhatsApp channel), phone_number_id (twilio, the bot number to send FROM — required when the bot owns more than one). If sending fails, it is NOT retried, and the timeline says the message MAY have gone out anyway — check the chat before trying again rather than sending twice. ATTACHMENT (twilio_direct only): document_id (a stored CallPilotAI document, sent via a short-lived signed link) or media_url (a public https file, e.g. a PDF). body becomes the caption and may then be empty. Never pass file contents.

chat_id.description: Beeper path: the Beeper chatID. Defaults to the WhatsApp channel linked to the lead.

contact_id.description: Recipient: a contact (person). Number: mobile, then phone.

content_sid.description: twilio_direct path: a Meta-approved template (Twilio ContentSid). Required OUTSIDE the 24-hour window, where free text is refused — send this instead of body.

content_variables.description: twilio_direct path: the template's variables, e.g. {"1": "Frau Muster"}. Only with content_sid.

document_id.description: twilio_direct: attach this stored document (documents.id). Use exactly one of document_id or media_url.

dry_run.description: Only resolve recipient, consent, route and chat - send nothing, create nothing.

lead_id.description: Recipient: a lead. Exactly one of lead_id, contact_id, to_number.

media_url.description: twilio_direct: attach the file at this public https address (PDF, image). Use exactly one of document_id or media_url.

phone_number_id.description: Twilio path: which of the bot's numbers to send from.

purpose.description: The processing purpose of this message (e.g. akquise, terminabstimmung). A consent is always for ONE purpose; without one, only the record's state and any withdrawal are checked. Refused outright if the tenant has switched on legal_basis_enforced.

to_number.description: Recipient without a record (E.164, e.g. +491701234567), matched via find_by_phone. Next to lead_id/contact_id: send to this number instead of the stored one.

name: send_whatsapp
